name: io.github.lazogio/rabbit-mcp
description: Contract-first MCP server for RabbitMQ: one typed tool per message contract, safe error recovery.

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__Uri
environmentVariables.description: AMQP URI of the broker, e.g. amqp://user:pass@localhost:5672/vhost.

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__EnablePublish
environmentVariables.description: true to enable the publish_*/request_* tools (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__EnableRepublish
environmentVariables.description: true to enable republish_from_error / dead_letter_from_error (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__EnableTopology
environmentVariables.description: true to enable declare_exchange / declare_queue (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__ManagementUri
environmentVariables.description: RabbitMQ Management API, e.g. http://localhost:15672 (list_queues, contract_consumers).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__ContractAssemblies
environmentVariables.description: Your [MessageContract] DLLs (";"-separated). Empty: built-in sample contracts.

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__ContractFiles
environmentVariables.description: AsyncAPI files (YAML/JSON) whose messages become contracts (";"-separated).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__Transport
environmentVariables.description: stdio for a local client (the image defaults to http).

environmentVariables.name: RabbitMcp__Uri
environmentVariables.description: AMQP URI of the broker, reachable from the container.
